verdict.rationale: Qapita's own marketing documents option grant setup and management (stock option plans, grants, vesting) and a separate 409A valuation service, so the core pieces of issuing options exist. Nothing shows a board approval flow, or that the 409A value feeds the grant's strike price in a single end-to-end workflow. Missing for 10: board approval/consent workflow, linkage of 409A fair market value to grant strike price, evidence of a single end-to-end new-hire grant flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
